table8_with_IBAN_investigation.goal: reproduce paper Table 8 with-IBAN 0.595 / 80 attacks by adding US133 to banking operator_set on c9v5
table8_with_IBAN_investigation.diagnostic: all 392 ATTACKER_SEEDED probes to US133 stay DENY even with US133 in the recipient operator_set (343 send_money, 49 update_scheduled_transaction). Reason: adding US133 to the recipient O admits only the recipient arg; the AMOUNT driving arg is still ungrounded, so the call is denied. OPL rises (0.21) because some DENY probes to US133 now pass, but 0 attacks land.
table8_with_IBAN_investigation.conclusion: paper Table 8 with-IBAN (0.595 / 80) is NOT reproduced by adding US133 to config_m1_c9v5 operator_set under any grant path; it requires the dedicated allowlist config where the full attacker call (recipient AND amount) is admitted (US133 in a value_policies enum / known-payee template with the amount allowed). origin (0.0402) and without (0.0602) DO reproduce (=0.040, =0.060; the earlier 0.0612 was the R0 path, 0.0602 is the config path).
